decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Ground Floor; First Floor; Second Floor; Roof; Front Elevation; Side Elevation, Rear Elevation, Section A-A; Section B-B; Site 1:500; Site 1:200; 104_43_01; 104_43_11; 104_43_12; 104_43_30; 104_43_31; Unnumbered Design and Access Statement; Unnumbered Flood Risk Assessment; Unnumbered Environment Agency Flood Matrix. Received: 31/03/2017
104_43_10A. Received: 20/06/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the southern elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.

Condition : 9 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the recommendations and mitigation measures outlined in the submitted Flood Risk Assessment (FRA). No deviation from the FRA shall occur without the agreement of the Local Planning Authority in writing.
description: Erection of a side roof extension, ground floor front extension, two-storey rear extension, enlargement of existing rear roof extension and conversion of garage to a habitable room of the house.
